channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: NASA's Swift sees black hole devouring a star, blazing like 10 billion suns
item.description: A supermassive black hole tore apart a star over 30,000 light-years from a distant galaxy's center.

item.title: NASA's Psyche spacecraft aces Mars flyby, captures stunning timelapse
item.description: The flyby used Mars' gravity to speed Psyche toward its 2029 rendezvous with a metal-rich asteroid.

item.title: NSF announces first awards to advance AI and cybersecurity education and workforce development through CyberAICorps Scholarship for Service Program
item.description: The U.S. National Science Foundation's Directorate for STEM Education today announced the inaugural awards under the CyberAICorps Scholarship for Service Program.

item.title: Twisted laser light can tell mirror-image molecules apart
item.description: Scientists have created twisted laser beams that interact differently with right-handed and left-handed molecules, revealing their identity through their distinct interactions.
